name: Basic Medical Coding Training
description: Medical coding is essential in healthcare because it converts procedures, diagnoses, and services into standardized alphanumeric codes. These codes play critical roles in billing, recordkeeping, research, and ensuring accurate insurance reimbursements
overview: This course provides essential skills and knowledge to kickstart a career in medical coding. Our meticulously crafted curriculum offers a deep understanding of healthcare coding essentials, preparing you for roles in medical coding departments, healthcare facilities, and insurance companies.

sections.title: Course Offerings:
sections.content: Participants will master the accurate translation of medical diagnoses, procedures, services, and equipment into standardized alphanumeric codes essential for billing, insurance claims, and data analysis.

sections.title: Course Topics:
content: Language of Medicines (Medical Terminology, Anatomy, Physiology, Pathology, Laboratory Techniques, etc.)
ICD-10-CM Coding Conventions and Chapter specific guidelines
Introduction to CPT Procedure Coding Terminologies
HCPCS basic Guidelines and Modifiers
Introduction on HIPAA rules and guidelines
HCPCS basic Guidelines and Modifiers concepts
Introduction to Revenue Cycle Management
Patient report analysis with sample Medical records
Final certification exam and Mock Interview
This course is designed to equip you with comprehensive skills...

sections.title: Highlights:
content: 12+ Years Experienced Certified Trainers
Free study materials and Manuals
Chapter wise Assessments every week
Final Certification Exam
Mock Interview to Crack Placements
100% Job Placement Assistance
24/7 Whatsapp Support for Doubt Clarification

sections.title: Who This Course Is For:
content: Life science students
Individuals interested in a career as a medical biller and coder
Practice consultants unfamiliar with the medical billing and coding process

name: Advanced Medical Code Training Program
description: This course aims to provide a foundational understanding of medical coding principles while preparing participants for the CPC certification exam administered by the American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC). It integrates basic coding skills with advanced training required for CPC certification.
overview: This course provides foundational skills in medical terminology, anatomy, and basic ICD-10-CM coding, along with advanced training in complex ICD-10-CM and CPT coding, HCPCS Level II coding, and compliance with coding guidelines. You'll also receive thorough preparation for the CPC certification exam, equipping you for roles in medical coding departments, healthcare facilities, and insurance companies
